root_cause: GitHub Actions scheduled events may be delayed or dropped. The authoritative repo Actions scheduled-run list for 2026-10-23 includes other workflows but no Powerhouse Daily Self Evolution; its latest observed scheduled run on 2026-10-22 failed. A job cron declaration is not evidence of actual daily learning.
source_evidence: GitHub API actions/runs?event=schedule&per_page=100 returned 15 scheduled runs dated 2026-10-23 and none named Powerhouse Daily Self Evolution
Existing hourly Repository Janitor already has actions:write and concurrency group, no new token or scheduler is needed
GitHub Docs troubleshooting workflows warns scheduled events can be delayed or dropped: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/troubleshoot-workflows
fix: Add one bounded liveness-check and missed-run dispatch to the EXISTING Janitor. At/after 06:47 UTC, verify today's active workflow runs via GitHub provider API and recheck before one requested workflow_dispatch to main. Preserve independent improve and model-freshness jobs, and record dispatch acceptance separately from terminal execution.
prevention_rule: No synthetic daily heartbeat or fake status. Failure, queued or in-progress run already present prevents duplicate dispatch. Provider read/truncation/invalid data or branch/ref uncertainty blocks recovery. Restore through same GitHub workflow only, never a new scheduler/agent/writer/queue; classify accepted dispatch as NOT execution proof.

invariants: GitHub provider run absence must be independently observed before dispatch
At most one recovery request from this Janitor evaluation
Two provider reads guard races and duplicate dispatches
An accepted dispatch is not terminal learning proof
Failed model-freshness stays red; no security or production gates skipped
No additional schedule, tokens, persistent authority or provider-paid preview

promotion: Release only on exact-head Required+CodeQL protected merge. Proof requires a later real Janitor artifact and an actual daily workflow run/job conclusion; mere PR or dispatch acceptance does not prove execution.
